sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Ab]I’m pressing on the upward way,
[Ab]New heights I’m gaining every day;
[Eb7/G]Still praying as [Ab]I’m onward bound,
[Ab]“Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.”

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Ab]Lord, lift me [Bbm]up [Ab]and let [Eb/G]me [Eb7]stand,
[Eb7]By faith, on Heaven's [Cm]table [Fm]land,
[Fm/Ab]A higher [Ab]plane than I have found;
[Ab]Lord, plant my feet on [Eb]higher [Ab]ground.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Ab]My heart has no desire to stay
[Ab]Where doubts arise and fears dismay;
[Eb7/G]Though some may [Ab]dwell where those abound,
[Ab]My prayer, my aim, is higher ground.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Ab]I want to live above the world,
[Ab]Though Satan's darts at me are hurled;
[Eb7/G]For faith has [Ab]caught the joyful sound,
[Ab]The song of saints on higher ground.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Ab]I want to scale the utmost height
[Ab]And catch a gleam of glory bright;
[Eb7/G]But still I'll [Ab]pray till Heav'n I've found,
[Ab]"Lord, plant my feet on higher ground."
